---
title: "prep_app_data"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
```

# Colleges
```{r}
# clean lat/lon and `college_type` (LAC/HBCU).
colleges <- read_csv("data/joined_colleges.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude)) %>%
  mutate(
    name = College,
    latitude = Latitude,
    longitude = Longitude,
    type = college_type,
    popup = sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>%s, %s<br/>Type: %s",
                     College, City, State, college_type),
    .keep = "none"
  )

colleges %>%
  count(type)
```

# Auto/EV facilities
```{r}
auto_facilities <- read_csv("data/auto_ev_map.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  mutate(
    name = facility_name,
    latitude, longitude,
    type = ifelse(EV_facility, "EV Facility", "Traditional/Other Facility"),
    popup = sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>%s<br/>%s, %s<br/>%s",
                     facility_name, company, city, state, products_or_focus),
    .keep = "none"
  )

auto_facilities %>%
  count(type)
```

# Theaters
```{r}
theaters <- read_csv("data/NRHP_LHAT_only_theaters.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  mutate(
    name = `Property Name`,
    latitude, longitude,
    type = ifelse(LHAT_member, "LHAT Member Theater", "NRHP-Listed Only"),
    popup = sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>%s, %s<br/>Listed: %s<br/>Type: %s",
                     `Property Name`, City, state, `Listed Date`,
                     ifelse(LHAT_member, "LHAT Member Theater", "NRHP-Listed Only")),
    .keep = "none"
  )

theaters %>% 
  count(type)
```

# Opera companies
```{r}
# Clean locations outside of the US and state names
us_states <- c(state.abb, "DC")

opera_raw <- read_csv("data/opera_america_members.csv")

clean_state <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- recode(x,
    "California"  = "CA", "Massachusetts" = "MA", "New Jersey" = "NJ",
    "New York"    = "NY", "Ohio" = "OH", "FLORIDA" = "FL",
    "nj" = "NJ", "New york " = "NY", .default = x
  )
  x <- str_remove(x, "`")
  x
}
```

```{r}
# Show what was modified by clean_state function
opera_raw %>%
  mutate(state_cleaned = clean_state(state)) %>%
  filter(state != state_cleaned) %>%
  count(state, state_cleaned, name = "n_rows") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_rows))
```

```{r}
# Checking rows that were dropped 
opera_raw %>%
  mutate(state_cleaned = clean_state(state)) %>%
  transmute(
    non_us_or_unmatched_state = !state_cleaned %in% us_states,
    missing_coordinates = is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude),
    test_or_blank_type = type %in% c("", "TEST") | is.na(type)
  ) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "drop_reason", values_to = "n_rows")
```

```{r}
# Clean data
opera <- opera_raw %>%
  mutate(state = clean_state(state)) %>%
  filter(
    state %in% us_states,
    !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude),
    !type %in% c("", "TEST"),
    !is.na(type)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    name = name,
    latitude, longitude,
    type = type,
    popup = sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>%s, %s<br/>Type: %s",
                     name, city, state, type),
    .keep = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
# Check opera counts
tibble(
  stage = c("Raw rows", "Rows kept after cleaning"),
  n = c(nrow(opera_raw), nrow(opera))
)

opera %>% 
  count(type) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
# Write new, cleaned CSVs to be used in the app
write_csv(colleges, "data/colleges_app_clean.csv")
write_csv(auto_facilities, "data/auto_facilities_app_clean.csv")
write_csv(theaters, "data/theaters_app_clean.csv")
write_csv(opera, "data/opera_app_clean.csv")
```
